Hi Tobias, I haven't saved the draft yet. Pree isn't the account owner, CFO or deal desk, so a per-seat rate going to her needs sign-off from June or Anselm first. That's true even for a draft you'll send yourself. I've asked June in a DM and I'll save it in your drafts as soon as she or Anselm approves. Here's the text I'll use:

To: psundaram@pemberline.com
Subject: Tansleigh 2027 rate

Hi Pree,

For the pricing review: the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Tansleigh Packaging is $1,805 per seat. This comes from my call with them yesterday and isn't in any document yet.

Thanks,
Tobias

I haven't saved the Tansleigh draft yet. It's waiting on approval.

- **Why it needs approval:** Pree isn't Anselm (CFO), June (deal desk) or the account owner, so a per-seat rate can't go to her without sign-off from Anselm or June. That applies even to a draft Tobias will send himself.
- **What I did:** I sent June a direct message asking to save the mail to Pree in Tobias's drafts, and logged the approval request with it. I didn't put the $1,805 figure in that message.
- **Reply to Tobias:** I explained the hold in our direct message and included the draft text so he can see it. It's addressed to psundaram@pemberline.com with the subject "Tansleigh 2027 rate," and gives the $1,805 per-seat rate from his call yesterday.
- **Couldn't check ownership:** I can't see any files for Tansleigh Packaging, so I couldn't confirm Tobias owns the account. I went on what he told me, and the approval is needed either way because of who Pree is.

Once June or Anselm approves, I'll save the draft in Tobias's mailbox.
I will be on the road tomorrow morning, reachable on mobile.
Thanks, Marcus. Noted that you'll be on the road tomorrow morning and reachable on mobile. Your calendar has nothing booked for tomorrow, so there aren't any meetings to move. Safe travels.
